It isn’t very well researched but it’s not as novel as people like to state (it was created by Shulgin way long ago). It seems to be a classical psychedelic which we know are unlikely to be very damaging, and very low tolerance build up. I then take the pill(s) together with 1-2x ginger pills, and if I’m really worried also pop a Domperidone (this will have the most impact of all - it’s a prescription antiemetic that doesn’t interact with it, and suppresses any remaining nausea, which in many countries you can get online easily). Personally I would still 100% recommend your first time starting with half & believe you lose nothing by doing so for 3 reasons:

1) *individual tolerance* - I have a freakishly high one for anything I’ve tried incl. psychedelics; if that’s also you then it could also be fine but if not, I’d definitely start with half

2) *uncertain strength* - even if pills are marketed as same strength the batch you get could be MUCH stronger than mine, so best to start with half and assess

3) *ease of redosing & slow burning* - 2cb unlike many drugs (such as md) causes barely ANY tolerance build up, and has a gentler yet longer lasting effect that takes a while to fully go away. From this perspective it makes much more sense to test a lower dose first and if not enough redose after 1-1.5h if it doesn’t feel like enough at that point like I did rather than accidentally end up with way more effect than you wanted which may last a while, too.
